title: Interplay between anisotropy and magnetic exchange to modulate the magnetic relaxation behaviours of phenoxo bridged Dy2 dimers with axial β-diketonate co-ligands

material_class.structural_family: Phenoxo-bridged Dy2 Schiff-base dimer with hexafluoroacetylacetonate co-ligands

synthesis.procedure: LH was dissolved in methanol and stirred with Dy(NO3)3·5H2O. Triethylamine was added after 20 minutes, followed by Hhfac. The mixture was stirred for 10 hours at ambient temperature and filtered; slow evaporation of the red solution gave red block-shaped crystals after approximately 5 days. The individual quantities section reports 0.20 mmol for the Dy salt, whereas the shared procedure reports 0.020 mmol.
synthesis.time: 20 minutes before triethylamine addition; 10 hours stirring; approximately 5 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution synthesis followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered the transparent red solution and allowed it to evaporate slowly, yielding red block-shaped single crystals.

properties.summary: The Dy2 dimer shows predominantly antiferromagnetic interactions at low temperature and zero-field slow magnetic relaxation. Its out-of-phase ac susceptibility lacks well-resolved peaks, attributed to fast quantum tunnelling.

measurements.name: Effective magnetic relaxation barrier
measurements.conditions: Zero dc field; fitted from ac susceptibility using the reported Bartolomé relation

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric molecular dimer with an approximately planar rhombic Dy2O2 core formed by two bridging phenolate oxygen atoms of antiparallel tridentate L ligands. Each eight-coordinate Dy(III) center has an O6N2 environment, including two chelating hfac anions, approximating a trigonal dodecahedron. The intramolecular Dy···Dy distance is 3.761(4) Å.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An isostructural analogue of 1 in which four tfac anions replace four hfac anions. Two tridentate L ligands bridge the Dy(III) ions through phenolate oxygen atoms to give a molecular Dy2O2 core. Each Dy(III) center is eight-coordinate with an approximately trigonal-dodecahedral O6N2 environment. The intramolecular Dy···Dy distance is 3.772(6) Å.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An asymmetric molecular dimer with a planar Dy2(μ2-O)2 core formed by two bridging phenolate groups of antiparallel tridentate L ligands. One eight-coordinate Dy(III) center binds two chelating thd anions; the other binds one thd and one chelating nitrate. Both have approximately trigonal-dodecahedral O6N2 coordination. The Dy···Dy distance is 3.842 Å. The reported crystal composition includes 1.5 water molecules per dimer.
